acquisition_method.evidence: Data were acquired using a data-independent acquisition (DIA) method with FAIMS-pro set to −45 CV.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins were first reduced and alkylated using 10 mM DTT (10 min, 70 °C) and 15 mM IAA (15 min, room temperature, dark), followed by binding to beads in 50% ethanol.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins were first reduced and alkylated using 10 mM DTT (10 min, 70 °C) and 15 mM IAA (15 min, room temperature, dark), followed by binding to beads in 50% ethanol.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Cell lysates denatured in 1× NuPAGE LDS sample buffer,were subjected to trypsin digestion using the SP3 protocol on a KingFisher APEX system.

The KingFisher APEX was programmed to perform sequential washing (3× with 80% ethanol) and digestion (37°C, 3.5 h) in 100 μL of TEAB buffer containing 0.5 μg Trypsin Gold (Mass Spectrometry Grade, dissolved in 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB, Thermo Fisher Scientific)).

ionization_type.evidence: connected to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a Dream Spray ING ion source (AMR).

labeling.evidence: Label-free, intensity-based protein quantification was performed using the Fragment Ions Quantifier node in Proteome Discoverer 3.2.

ptm.evidence: Methionine oxidation and diglycine-lysine were set as variable modifications, and cysteine carbamidomethylation was set as a static modification for database searching.
